title: Concept: JSON response carries a stack trace field
description: A serialised exception carries the stack, and the stack names absolute paths, framework versions and the internal call structure. Returning it to a client turns an API error into a map of the deployment, and it is usually a one-line mistake in an error handler.
applicability: Responses generated by a service that serialises its exception objects.
risk: The caller learns file paths, dependency versions and the internal call graph, which supports targeted exploitation and version-specific attacks.
